scripts.check: node --check backend/server.mjs && node -e "const { readdirSync } = require('fs'); const { join } = require('path'); const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); for (const file of readdirSync('frontend/js').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.js'))) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', join('frontend/js', file)], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
